descricao_original: Peripheral nerves can be found coursing through tissues of the body. Generally, nerves appear well demarcated from surrounding tissue due to the presence of the perineurium. Nerves do not have a lumen and often have a wavy appearance in longitudinal section. These two characteristics distinguish nerves from blood vessels or the ducts of glands. 400x
